correctness.rationale: Fourier inversion of the labelled powers gives lag-h coded autocorrelation with unit phase zeta^(-a h^2+b h) and coefficients f(j)f(j-h)zeta^(2ahj). For odd prime p and a nonzero, cyclotomic minimal-polynomial rigidity forces any autocorrelation difference coefficients at a fixed nonzero lag to be constant; equal Hamming weight eliminates nonzero constants. Thus every unordered support of size at least 2 is recovered. Every singleton still has intensity 1; zero has zero weight. Composite N permits explicit two-site translated collisions: even d=N/2,s=1 and odd d proper divisor, s=N/d; a=0 mod prime yields translation collisions. Field norm >=1 and other p-2 embeddings <=p give the conservative p^{-(p-2)} separation bound; inverse Fourier is an L-infinity contraction. Independent integer-basis cyclotomic key calculations checked all 2^p binary patterns for p=3,5,7 and every nonzero slope, and explicit composite witnesses N=4,9,15. The finite tests do not prove the universal theorem.
